# Nexow

> Nexow turns plain-language ideas into live widgets on a free-form canvas.
> Describe a moodboard, habit planner, mini game, social view, market dashboard,
> data tool or private workflow and Nexow generates a working widget, runs it in
> a sandboxed iframe, and lets you arrange it in your workspace. Trading remains
> a first-class use case: Nexow's connector and live-data layer was originally
> built around trading desks, market data APIs and alerts, then generalized to
> other workflows. Nexow is private
> by default: in local mode, codegen runs in your browser with your own Anthropic
> API key and widgets persist locally in IndexedDB. Accounts, connectors, bots,
> community and marketplace features are optional layers around the core widget
> canvas.

## Key facts

- Category: AI-native widget workspace / free-form app canvas, with sandboxed generated widgets and optional data connectors.
- Not trading-only, but trading-first foundations: trading was the first demanding use case and remains first-class; the same API/data connector foundation now also supports moodboards, habit planners, mini games, social widgets, personal systems, data tools and internal dashboards.
- How it works: prompt → AI-generated widget source → sandboxed iframe runtime → themed canvas → optional connectors / local state → refine in natural language.
- Structure: Workspaces contain Screens, which hold Widgets on a free-form canvas. Groups bundle widgets with mosaic or tab layouts; Links pipe events or data between widgets, one-way or two-way.
- Privacy: private by default and no account required; bring-your-own-key codegen runs client-side; widgets, versions and logs stored in the browser (IndexedDB); many services connect browser-direct.
- Advanced layers: bots, agents, Copilot, community, marketplace and XP rewards exist or are on the roadmap, but the home page positions them as secondary to the widget canvas.
- Accounts: free, no credit card. Cross-device cloud sync is LIVE; 10,000 AI credits are reserved at sign-up and activate when platform mode opens.
- Connectors (28 live, 56 in catalog): databases and data tools such as Postgres, ClickHouse and Qdrant; socials such as X, YouTube, Discord, Telegram and Spotify; market venues such as OANDA, Binance, Coinbase, Kraken, Deribit, BitMEX, Alpaca, Interactive Brokers, TradeStation, Polygon, Kalshi and Polymarket.
- Markets remain supported: FX, crypto, equities, futures, options and prediction markets are still first-class examples, not the whole product.
- AI models: Anthropic Claude via the Anthropic SDK — Claude Opus 4.8 (default), Sonnet 4.6 and Haiku 4.5.
- Plans: free forever to build (locally with your own key, or with 10,000 AI credits reserved on a free account). Paid plans — Supporter ($9.99/mo, 50K credits, 30 bots, 10 agents) and Sponsor ($69.99/mo, 800K credits, 300 bots, 100 agents) — plus Partner (custom, for teams). Yearly billing gives two months free. Paid checkout and platform credits are coming soon.
- Status: public preview live (canvas, codegen, connectors, cloud bots, accounts & sync, community feed). Roadmap: agent deploy, Copilot, marketplace, templates/workflows, XP & rewards.
- App: https://x.nexow.ai
